task.title: EARTR-ESC-R1 Round-Trip 1.2 Candidate Contract Implementation
task.objective: Implement the accepted typed two-lane absorption-candidate, dual-reader, deterministic Local binding, and candidate-aware validation receipt semantics within exactly four existing owners.
nonGoals: Do not create a new protocol, profile, schema, registry, runtime, truth owner, receipt owner, authority owner, or state machine.
Do not modify public or portable packet representations in this worker tranche.
Do not stage, commit, push, publish, deploy, call providers, use credentials, or claim protocol 1.2.0 released.

gateA.name: SOURCE_OWNER_OVERLAP
requiredEvidence: Recompute every pinned input hash before edits.
Read the accepted design, external closure, baseline, work order, task capsule, and all four owner paths.
Confirm dispatch-base ancestry, clean worktree, empty staging, and exact five-path worker ownership.
Confirm no competing validator, finding-workflow, protocol-version, or receipt owner exists.

gateB.name: DESIGN_CODE_TEST
requiredEvidence: Implement mutually exclusive external-source-value and internal-CVF-defect candidate variants.
Implement candidateContractVersion 1 dual reading without legacy promotion.
Bind PASS receipts to exact manifest, protocol version, and candidate-contract version.
Add focused positive, negative, contamination, reference-integrity, dual-reader, receipt-mismatch, and authority-widening tests.
Return exact changed-set and empty-staging evidence.
